notes:
A new home screen. Checking in and out is a small button at the top beside your name — the big card it used to live in is gone, and the times you punched are on the line under your name. Quick actions now sit at the top of the page, above your leave and your attendance, because they are what most people open the app for.

And Quick actions are yours to choose. Tap Edit above the grid and pin whatever you actually use — the number on each one shows where it will sit. "More" stays put at the end and always opens the full list of modules. Everyone starts with My Cashbook, My Incentive, Tasks, Learning, Notices, Change Requests and Regularization; your choices are kept on your account, so a new phone brings them with you.

My Incentive is new. One tab lists your points day by day and says where each one came from — a day you were on a rolling team, a day your team shared its cut with you, or points credited to you with the reason attached — along with what the company has actually paid you this month. The other is a leaderboard, with a department filter, showing how you compare on points earned. It shows points earned and nothing else: what anybody has been paid, or is still owed, stays private. Which departments you can see there is set by your Super Admin.

Photographing a bill no longer leaves the app. My Cashbook used to hand the phone to your camera app, and on a lot of phones Android would close the app while it was away — you would come back to a restarted app with your half-typed entry gone. The camera is now part of the screen, with a button to flip between the front and back lenses and a look at the photo before you attach it. The same camera is now offered for your profile and banner pictures.

Cash In has gone from My Cashbook. Money coming towards you is the company's advance, so that is a button of its own now — "Ask for an advance" — and it opens the form straight away instead of asking which kind of money it is first. It is asked for against your wallet and never against a particular book. If you have spent past your advance, asking to be paid back is still on the wallet card where it was.

Fixed: if your incentive points came from being in a day's non-rolling group, your home screen was not counting those days and could show you as owed nothing. It now counts them, and agrees with the day-by-day list behind it.
